run_collate_data: run the collate script to merge summaries and negatives into combined dataset JSON files
run_ensure_size: run ensure_size to validate and strip text to a maximum CLIP token length of 77
review_run_collate: review the run_collate function that joins annotation summaries and negatives into complete dataset entries
refactor_ensure_size: refactor ensure_size to support a configurable maximum CLIP token length instead of the default 77
summarize_collate_script: summarize the collate_data script that loads generated summaries and negatives into combined JSON files for data loading
